vocab.books.reco.sub.zh-CN: 按热门排序；以后按你的水平推荐。
vocab.books.reco.sub.en: Sorted by popularity today; ranked by your level later.

vocab.books.reco.failed.zh-CN: 推荐词书没能加载出来（不影响下面的词单）。
vocab.books.reco.failed.en: Recommended books could not be loaded. Your word lists below are unaffected.

vocab.books.reco.empty.zh-CN: 暂时没有可推荐的词书。
vocab.books.reco.empty.en: No books to recommend right now.

vocab.books.libraryEmptyLink.zh-CN: 还没有词？去词单页挑一本词书
vocab.books.libraryEmptyLink.en: No words yet? Pick a book on the word lists page

vocab.books.detail.previewSub.zh-CN: 每页 50 词；内容与复习卡用的是同一份。
vocab.books.detail.previewSub.en: 50 words per page; the cards use the same content.

vocab.books.detail.joinNote.zh-CN: 加入后会在「我的词单」生成一份副本，并立刻可以开始背；已背过的词进度不变。
vocab.books.detail.joinNote.en: Joining creates one copy in My word lists and lets you start at once. Progress on words you already study does not change.

vocab.books.detail.noWords.zh-CN: 这本书还没有词条，暂时不能加入。
vocab.books.detail.noWords.en: This book has no entries yet, so it cannot be joined.

vocab.books.detail.joinedToast.zh-CN: 已加入：新增 {created} 词，词库里已有 {duplicated} 词。
vocab.books.detail.joinedToast.en: Joined: {created} words added, {duplicated} already in your library.

vocab.books.detail.emptyEntries.en: This book has no entries yet.

vocab.books.review.missingBook.zh-CN: 缺少词书编号，无法开始复习。
vocab.books.review.missingBook.en: The book id is missing, so the review cannot start.

vocab.books.admin.sub.zh-CN: 只有管理员能改；学生只读。词书只能下架，不能删除。
vocab.books.admin.sub.en: Only administrators can edit. Students read these books. Books can be unpublished but never deleted.

vocab.books.admin.emptyList.zh-CN: 还没有词书。先新建一本，再批量导入词条。
vocab.books.admin.emptyList.en: No books yet. Create one, then import its entries.

vocab.books.admin.descriptionPlaceholder.zh-CN: 这本书收什么词、按什么分册
vocab.books.admin.descriptionPlaceholder.en: What this book covers and how it is organised

vocab.books.admin.languageHint.zh-CN: 词条语言；v1 只有 en（内容包与取词链路都只支持 en）。
vocab.books.admin.languageHint.en: Language of the entries; v1 supports en only (both the content pack and word lookup are en-only).

vocab.books.admin.levelHint.zh-CN: 仅展示，不参与筛选与推荐。
vocab.books.admin.levelHint.en: Display only; not used for filtering or recommendations.

vocab.books.admin.positionHint.zh-CN: 数字小的排在前面；相同时列表按创建时间、推荐位按加入人数降序。
vocab.books.admin.positionHint.en: Smaller numbers come first; ties sort by creation time in lists and by member count in recommendations.

vocab.books.admin.entriesHint.zh-CN: 与「加词」页共用同一套粘贴/上传与预览，含格式清洗与拼写检查。
vocab.books.admin.entriesHint.en: Uses the same paste, upload and preview flow as the add-words page, including cleanup and spelling checks.

vocab.books.admin.noDelete.zh-CN: 词书只能下架、不能删除；下架不会清掉学生已加入的词与副本。
vocab.books.admin.noDelete.en: Books can only be unpublished, never deleted. Unpublishing keeps every word and copy students already joined.

vocab.books.admin.positionInvalid.en: Position must be a whole number.

vocab.books.import.sub.zh-CN: 与「加词」共用同一套解析、清洗与预览，只是提交目标换成这本书。
vocab.books.import.sub.en: Same parser, cleanup and preview as the add-words page; only the destination changes to this book.

vocab.books.import.done.zh-CN: 已导入：新建 {created} 个，重复 {duplicated} 个。
vocab.books.import.done.en: Imported: {created} added, {duplicated} already in the book.

vocab.books.detail.previewFailed.zh-CN: 预览没能加载出来（不影响加入）。
vocab.books.detail.previewFailed.en: The preview could not be loaded. Joining still works.

vocab.books.admin.notFound.zh-CN: 找不到这本词书（可能已被下架或删除），刷新列表再看看。
vocab.books.admin.notFound.en: That book was not found. It may have been unpublished or removed; reload the list.

vocab.books.admin.entriesCreateHint.zh-CN: 先贴词条再点「保存」，建书和导入一次完成；留空也行，保存后再回来补。
vocab.books.admin.entriesCreateHint.en: Paste entries before you save: the book is created and the entries are imported in one go. Leave it empty to add them later.

vocab.books.admin.importResult.zh-CN: 本次导入：新增 {created} 条，已存在/重复 {duplicated} 条，失败 {failed} 条。
vocab.books.admin.importResult.en: Last import: {created} added, {duplicated} already present or duplicated, {failed} failed.

vocab.books.admin.createdWithEntries.zh-CN: 已创建「{name}」，并导入 {created} 条词条。

vocab.books.admin.savedWithEntries.zh-CN: 已保存，并导入 {created} 条词条。

vocab.books.admin.importAfterCreateFaile.zh-CN: 词书已创建，但词条导入失败：{message}。粘贴内容还在，再点一次「保存」就是重试导入。
vocab.books.admin.importAfterCreateFaile.en: The book was created, but importing the entries failed: {message}. Your pasted text is still here; press Save again to retry.

vocab.books.admin.importFailed.zh-CN: 元信息已保存，但词条导入失败：{message}。粘贴内容还在，再点一次「保存」就是重试导入。
vocab.books.admin.importFailed.en: Metadata saved, but importing the entries failed: {message}. Your pasted text is still here; press Save again to retry.
